Name: The Undertale Cookbook
Author: larkylovesyou2
Description:
Hello Undertale/Deltarune fans! Have you ever wondered what "sequins and glue" are meant to taste like? Well, this mod probably won't help you with that. But at least you'll have some more interesting things for your farmer to eat!

This mod adds 15 cooking recipes inspired by the hit game Undertale: Glamburger, Junk Food, Hush Puppy, Cinnamon Bunny, Sea Tea, Monster Candy, Spider Cider, Spider Donut, Starfait, Dog Salad, Steak in the Shape of Mettaton's Face, Legendary Hero, Butterscotch Pie, Snail Pie, and Quiche! You can also find Crab Apples, a new fruit, by fishing with Crab Pots. There's also a super-special hidden snack that I'll let you find on your own...


:: RECIPES ::

Glamburger: 
- 1 Star Shards
- 10 Sap 
- 1 Bread 

Junk Food:
- 1 Trash 
- 1 Soggy Newspaper 
- 1 Broken CD 

Hush Puppy:
-1 Oil 
-1 Corn 
-1 Milk (Any) 
-1 Egg (Any) 
-1 Spring Onion 

Cinnamon Bunny:
-1 Wheat Flour
-1 Sugar
-1 Milk (Any) 
-1 Egg (Any)

Sea Tea:
-1 Sea Jelly 
-1 Tea Leaves

Monster Candy:
-2 Bat Wings
-1 Sugar

Spider Cider:
-1 Apple
-2 Bug Meat

Spider Donut:
-1 Spider Cider
-1 Wheat Flour
-1 Oil

Starfait:
-1 Starfruit
-1 Milk (Any)
-1 Sugar

Dog Salad:
-3 Slime
-1 Seaweed

Face Steak:
-1 Eggplant
-3 Eggs (Any)
-1 Energy Tonic

Legendary Hero:
-2 Bread
-1 Tomato
-2 Kale
-1 Eggplant

Butterscotch Pie:
-1 Milk (Any)
-2 Egg (Any)
-2 Wheat Flour
-1 Spice Berry

Snail Pie: 
-1 Milk (Any)
-2 Egg (Any)
-2 Wheat Flour
-2 Snails

Quiche:
-3 Eggs (Any)
-1 Milk (Any)
-1 Bok Choy
-1 Cheese
